fieldNotes._identity: Address given (2500 E Belt Line Rd) is Walmart's 1.5M sf fulfillment center; the 730k sf Perishable DC is the adjacent building at 940 E Pleasant Run Rd in the same Lancaster logistics campus. Audited the perishable building (south, diagonal WNW-ESE footprint). Refrigeration confirmed by ammonia/refrigerant tank farm visible in 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes._imagery: Satellite is construction-era (Maxar, ~2022-2023): both buildings still bare concrete / under construction, yards ungraded, so dock-door and trailer counts are estimates from footprint + completed 2026 Street View, not exact overhead counts.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire complex is fully fenced (continuous chain-link perimeter visible in 2026 Street View, Walmart trailers parked behind the fence line). Single controlled truck entrance off the west perimeter drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from facility profile (730k sf high-tech automated DC, 500+ associates, fully fenced) - construction-era satellite cannot resolve a booth and no Street View pano sits at the gate; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court between buildings and a south yard provide internal queue/hold room before docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band: 730k sf cross-dock-style perishable DC with long dock faces on north (shared apron with FC) and south; door rhythm not fully resolvable in construction imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on two distinct building faces (north apron between PDC and FC; south yard), consistent with separate ship/receive banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band: long rows of Walmart trailers backed in along the dock face in 2026 Street View, plus a large south drop yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and deep west perimeter drive with ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: this Perishable DC shares the site with Walmart's 1.5M sf fulfillment center immediately north/west.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town: complex sits among farmland with woods to the north and east (2026 Street View), 15 mi south of Dallas - judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 143 acres derived from the perimeter polygon (Perishable DC parcel incl. truck yard and landscaped buffers).
